title: Most popular websites based on Tranco ranking
subtitle: 2020 to 2026
hook: Explore the shifting landscape of the world's most popular websites from 2020 through 2026.
setup: This data race tracks composite website rankings based on the Tranco ranking system over multiple years.

sequence.text: Netflix appears in the ranking as a newcomer in 2020.
Amazonaws.com makes a significant jump in ranking by 2024.

ending: A look back at how top website rankings evolved over the years.
